subject: Ops onboarding template for vector vendors — intake & SLA asks
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops onboarding template for vector vendors — intake & SLA asks

Morning team,

Following up on the VectorPath intro — they're a promising ISV for hybrid vector storage with a strong S3-tiering story. Before we add them as a verified partner in the Marketplace, ops needs a concise intake that captures technical, commercial and SLO expectations.

I've sketched a simple onboarding template (see attachment request below) and an SLA checklist we should use as our baseline for partners providing store/index services. Can each of you review and flag any non-starters? Specific asks: 
- Ben: operational runbook gaps (backups, reindex, eviction)
- Vanessa: commercial terms we need for a marketplace listing (rev share, trial limits)
- Aditya: security/compliance checkpoint we must enforce (authz, audit logs, encryption-in-transit/rest)

Plan: I want to send the intake to VectorPath tomorrow so they can fill and return; please reply with comments by EOD.

Attachments: request for "vendor-intake-template.xlsx" and "sla-checklist.pdf" (stubs).

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Miguel Torres <miguel@vectorpath.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@vectorpath.com
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Ops onboarding template for vector vendors — intake & SLA asks

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the note — excited to get this moving. Happy to complete your intake; a couple quick clarifying questions from our side before we start: 
1) For the SLA uptime target, do you require a region-specific SLO (e.g., us-west vs eu-west) or will a global SLO suffice for the first pass?
2) On data residency: we offer configurable residency and an S3-backed cold tier in us-east and eu-west — do you need proof-of-residency for both regions to list?
3) For the audit logs you mentioned, can you point us to the exact log retention window Redwood expects for Marketplace partners?

If you prefer, I can take a first stab at filling the template and mark items we need Redwood to confirm.

Best,
Miguel Torres
Head of Partnerships, VectorPath Inc.
miguel@vectorpath.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 13:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ops onboarding template for vector vendors — intake & SLA asks

Kim,

Solid starting point. Quick operational notes below — I'll attach a copy of the intake with inline comments (vendor-intake-template.xlsx). High-level items: 
- Reindex/backfill: require documented throttles and an emergency stop API. We should add a field asking for "max concurrent reindex threads per shard" and expected IOPS.
- Backups: need snapshot cadence and RPO/RTO targets. If they rely solely on S3 lifecycle, note that as acceptable but require restore SLAs.
- Eviction/TTL behavior: must be explicit — how tombstones are managed, whether deletes are eventual vs hard.
- Observability: require a prometheus endpoint (or hosted equivalent) and tokenized access for our ops team.

I flagged these in the attachment. Also added a recommended acceptance test: a 10k-doc ingest + 1 query-per-sec for 30 mins to validate latency under cold+warm loads.

Ben
Principal Engineer, Vector Integrations
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: vendor-intake-template.xlsx (commented)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Torres <miguel@vectorpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ops onboarding template for vector vendors — intake & SLA asks

Miguel — thanks for the quick reply. Answering your questions inline and next steps: 

- Region SLOs: For initial Marketplace listing, global SLO is acceptable but please specify region-specific targets if you support multi-region deployments. We mark region variance on the listing.
- Proof-of-residency: Please supply for the regions you intend to list (us-east and eu-west). A technical note or architecture diagram pointing to the S3 buckets/regions is fine; we don't need full attestations for the first pass.
- Audit log retention: Redwood requires a minimum of 90 days of immutable audit logs for partners that access customer data. If you can retain longer, please indicate retention windows per region.

Next steps: 
1) Miguel — if you can return the attached intake with the fields filled and any diagrams by next Wed (2027-06-09), we will run a light intake review and schedule a 45-min acceptance test slot with Ben's team.
2) Vanessa — can you draft the marketplace commercial blurb and suggested trial caps (e.g., 500k vectors free trial, then tiered pricing) by Monday?
3) Aditya — please confirm the security checkpoint list (I copied Ben's observability ask) and create a short checklist we can attach to the vendor page.

We'll also link the drive folder with the intake and a DocuSign template for a minimal partner addendum. Linking both in case Miguel wants to sign the addendum after the intake review: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bVecPartnerOnboard

Thanks all — sending Miguel the intake now.

Best,
Kimberly
